name: Mona Albrecht
source:
The owner of a family restaurant who loves cooking and socializing and has a keen heart to succeed. She has known Nina since she was a kid and sees her as a little sister. 

She likes to stay close yet distant with everyone. She seems to have a complicated history with the Handels. Her mother passed away a long time ago. 

She has witnessed Nina growing up but seems to have a love-hate relationship seeing Nina living a carefree life. She doesn't want Nina to find out about her dark side, so she wants to protect Nina's innocence.

[Edited from in-game bio]
